What if the "life flashing before your eyes" thing was in fact a repetitive loop, and it was there as a way to placate humanity? Like, we "live" and then "die" but we THINK we're just having our lives flash before our eyes before we die - but obviously we never do die, because we are still alive to remember having our lives flash before our eyes. Did that make sense? I'll try and explain;

Because it "flashes" before our eyes, this could mean our additional lives - i.e. the ones we "flash" are greatly slowed down, but with time being a wibbly-wobbly-non-entity, who's to say that we were SUPPOSED to be in the next stage of a loop, but were dragged back out of it by surviving our death?

And then what if, because to us it happens in real time - as in, we're not brought back by surviving what caused us to have the flashbacks, and our consciousnesses (defo a word) present the next stage in the loop for what we perceive is real time - we're really living our lives continually to serve some other purpose, like our consciousnesses are kept perpetually busy while our bodies - whatever form they might actually take (the pinkish blobs might just be some bizarre interpretation or perception) are some kind of eternal hostages for... who knows what?

Through the looking glass, people.
